protocol.failure_rule: charged, recorded as NULL, excluded from the GP
protocol.gp: fixed RBF length_scale=0.25 + WhiteKernel(1e-4), normalised y, no hyper-optimisation
protocol.hot_start_rule: learning arms: model-predicted lowest means; SOBOL_BO: pool order; shared exploration points identical across arms
protocol.target: log(CDi / J_ref); J_ref is the billed baseline anchor of the same task (data/s2/labels_manifest.json)
